publisher: Hambleton District Council / North Yorkshire Council archived planning service
evidence_slice: Hambleton District Council's Local Plan 2022 was adopted on 22 February 2022. The adopted Local Plan allocation map service exposes layer 274 'Allocations' as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer with fields Policy_Ref, Policy_Desc and Site_Name and GeoJSON support. Policy HG1 identifies AIB 2, South of Lyngarth Farm, Bedale, for 60 homes, and a post-adoption June 2022 planning committee report confirms AIB 2 allocates the site for housing and forms part of the Council's housing land supply.

field_evidence.post_adoption_confirmation: June 2022 planning committee report states AIB 2 allocates the site for housing and forms part of the Council housing land supply

binding_method: adopted Local Plan exact site allocation bound to authority-hosted esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and post-adoption housing-supply confirmation; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: Official policy and ArcGIS sources were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file bytes / exact AIB 2 polygon response bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
